cues.zh: “叠氮化叠氮”，有史以来最具爆炸性的化合物
cues.en: "Azidoazide azide", the most explosive chemical compound ever created

cues.zh: 这种敏感的小化合物属于一类被称为
cues.en: This twitchy little compound is a part of a class of chemicals known as

cues.zh: “高氮含能材料”的化学品
cues.en: "High nitrogen energetic materials"

cues.zh: 它之所以如此，是因为氮只想独处
cues.en: And it does what it does because nitrogen just wants to be left alone

cues.zh: 一个氮原子与另一个氮原子结合，是地球上最稳定的分子之一
cues.en: A nitrogen atom bonded with another nitrogen atom is one of the most stable molecules on earth

cues.zh: 它们的电子彼此形成极强的三键，
cues.en: Their electrons form an extremely strong triple bond with each other,

cues.zh: 在自然界中，通常只有分子被闪电击中才能打破这种键
cues.en: which, in nature can usually only be broken by a molecule being hit by lightning

cues.zh: 这种键的强度意味着，当两个氮原子猛地结合时，
cues.en: The strength of that bond means that when two nitrogen atoms snap together,

cues.zh: 会释放出巨大的能量。
cues.en: they release a tremendous amount of energy.

cues.zh: 所以如果你看看AA分子……我们叫它AA，因为叠氮化叠氮太难念了
cues.en: So if you look in a molecule of AA.. We're gonna call it AA cause Azidoazide Azide is hard

cues.zh: 你就能看出它的爆炸力从何而来。
cues.en: You can see how it gets its bang.

cues.zh: 它有14个氮原子，由于分子的结构方式，
cues.en: It has 14 nitrogen atoms and because of the way the molecule was structured,

cues.zh: 它们都不在三键中。
cues.en: None of them are in a triple bond.

cues.zh: 相反，它们处于松散结合的高能态，
cues.en: Instead, they're stuck in a loosely bound high-energy state

cues.zh: 急切地想转移到更稳定的低能态，
cues.en: and are dying to move to a more stable lower energy state

cues.zh: 这意味着在这个过程中会释放大量积压的能量。
cues.en: which means releasing a lot of pent-up energy in the process.

cues.zh: 结果，AA既高度活泼又极其易爆。
cues.en: As a result, AA is both highly reactive and heck-a explosive.

cues.zh: 这东西有多敏感？其实很难说，因为它太敏感了，

cues.en: even to measure how sensitive it is.

cues.en: A team of German chemists created it in 2010 with the help of the US army,

cues.en: And their first report on the discovery,

cues.zh: ……即使在冲击和摩擦测试中施加最小可能的载荷，也会导致爆炸性分解。”
cues.en: ...even the smallest possible loadings in shock & friction-tests led to explosive decomposition."

cues.zh: 为了让大家了解这东西有多敏感，
cues.en: To give you a list of how touchy this stuff is,

cues.zh: 把它放进光谱仪、打开光谱仪，

cues.zh: 还有我最喜欢的：什么都不做！！！
cues.en: and my favourite: ABSOLUTELY NOTHING!!!

cues.zh: 他们把它放在防爆箱里，置于黑暗的恒温恒湿房间中……
cues.en: They had it in a shock-proof explosive case, in a dark climate controlled room...

cues.zh: 然后它炸了！
cues.en: and it blew up!

cues.zh: 我觉得是有人在某处说了它什么坏话，然后它就：

cues.zh: （消音哔——）

cues.en: But that is not what makes it so dangerous

cues.en: Like lungs and your kidneys and liver, creating compounds that rip electrons off the atoms of your cells

cues.en: But, when they broke it apart into thioacetone workers started falling ill

cues.en: but, understandably, scientists are not really rushing to look into it

cues.zh: 氟锑酸
cues.en: Fluoroantimonic acid

cues.zh: 因为一份危险化学品清单，怎么能少了
cues.en: Because what list of dangerous chemicals would be complete

cues.zh: 一种超强酸呢
cues.en: without a super acid

cues.zh: 酸之所以为酸，在于它能向附近的另一个分子提供一个质子
cues.en: What makes an acid an acid is its ability to donate a proton to another molecule nearby it

cues.zh: 而质子就是失去了电子的氢原子
cues.en: And a proton is just a hydrogen atom that's lost its electron

cues.zh: 这个过程叫做质子化
cues.en: This process is called Protonation

cues.zh: 酸的强度取决于它有多愿意交出那个质子
cues.en: And an acid's strength is determined by how willing it is to give up that proton

cues.zh: 弱酸，比如乙酸
cues.en: A weak acid, acetic acid for example

cues.zh: 也就是未稀释的醋
cues.en: Which is just the undiluted form of vinegar

cues.zh: 在质子化其他分子时会磨磨蹭蹭
cues.en: will drag its feet about protonating other molecules

cues.zh: 大部分就待在那里什么也不做
cues.en: Most of it will just sit there doing nothing

cues.zh: 但像硫酸这样的强酸，会把那个质子像春假沙滩排球一样狠狠扣出去
cues.en: But a strong acid like sulfuric acid'll punch that proton in the air like a beach volleyball at spring break

cues.zh: 还记得在《物质》N 里，氟有多疯狂吧
cues.en: And remember from Substance N how crazy fluorine is

cues.zh: 氟锑酸的强度是硫酸的一千万亿倍
cues.en: Well, fluoroantimonic acid is ten quadrillion times stronger than sulfuric acid

cues.zh: 这个分子随时都想找个借口散架
cues.en: This molecule is begging for an excuse to fly apart

cues.zh: 一旦它失去了氢原子
cues.en: Once it's lost its hydrogen atoms

cues.zh: 剩下的氟原子和另一种元素锑
cues.en: the remaining atoms of fluorine and another element, antimony

cues.zh: 就会撕碎周围的一切，从附近的分子上扯下电子
cues.en: tear through everything else around them, ripping electrons off nearby molecules

cues.zh: 身后只留下一摊有机残渣
cues.en: and leaving just organic goo in their wake

cues.zh: 特别刺激的是，氟特别喜欢和钙结合
cues.en: Especially exciting is that fluorine really likes to bond with calcium

cues.zh: 所以一旦这种酸蚀穿你皮肤和肌肉的脂肪有机组织
cues.en: So once the acid tears through the fatty organic tissues of your skin and muscles

cues.zh: 氟就会一路烧穿你的骨头
cues.en: the fluorine will burn through your bones

cues.zh: 储存氟锑酸的唯一办法是用特氟龙容器
cues.en: The only way to store fluoroantimonic acid is in Teflon containers

cues.zh: 顺便说一句，特氟龙是靠碳-氟键结合在一起的
cues.en: Teflon, by the way, is held together by carbon-fluorine bonds

cues.zh: 而这是有机化学中最强的单键
cues.en: which are the single strongest bond in organic chemistry

cues.zh: 其实我们对这种酸了解不多，因为拿它做实验太难了
cues.en: We don't actually know a lot about this acid because it's so hard to do experiments with it

cues.zh: 你没法把它装进注射器或滴到载玻片上
cues.en: You can't put it in a syringe or on a slide

cues.zh: 它蚀穿玻璃就像吃棉花糖一样
cues.en: It eats through glass like it's cotton candy

cues.zh: 你也不能把它放进通风橱——它会把通风橱吃掉
cues.en: You can't put it under a fume hood - it'll eat the fume hood

cues.zh: 你真正能做的，基本上就是看着它
cues.en: All you can really do is, just like, look at it

cues.zh: 最好是从……
cues.en: Ideally from...

cues.zh: ……非常遥远
cues.en: ...very far away

cues.zh: 感谢观看这期特别危险的SciShow infusion
cues.en: Thank you for watching this particularly dangerous SciShow infusion

cues.zh: 特别感谢我们的Subbable订阅者，是你们帮助我们为他们制作这档节目
cues.en: Thank you especially to our Subbable subscribers who help us make this show for them

cues.zh: 至于其他人，想了解如何支持我们，可以访问subbable.com
cues.en: And for everyone else, to find our how you can support us you can go to subbable.com

cues.zh: 如果你想继续和我们一起变得更聪明？
cues.en: And if you want to keep getting smarter with us?

cues.zh: 只需访问youtube.com/scishow并订阅
cues.en: Just go to youtube.com/scishow and subscribe
